title: More community projects to explore
summary:
The community showcase grew by fourteen projects while tier lookups, mistral-fast requests, and event recording got reliability fixes.

Thirteen projects were added to the showcase, spanning terminal chat, image galleries, stickers, and PDF-to-speech. ViralFlow AI joined the creative projects list with a workflow that uses Pollinations images in generated videos. Ten existing project descriptions were also clarified; those edits change the listings, not the apps.

Customer-state and tier routes now reuse cached Polar responses to reduce rate-limit errors. A separate fix corrects product lookups so active subscriptions can return their tier name and daily Pollen allowance instead of “Unknown Tier” and “0 pollen/day.”

The Bedrock configuration for Llama 3.1 8B (`mistral-fast`) now requests at most 4096 output tokens, below the model’s limit. This prevents validation errors caused by the previous default.
